review_description: Logan was really thorough during the quoting process and answered all our questions. He offered great quality components at a competitive price and his recommendations were spot on for our situation. Installation was completed in a day and the system was up and running that afternoon. I then contacted Logan 2 months later to install a Tesla Gen 3 wall charger which was again competitively priced and works seamlessly. Overall, we're really happy with Pacific Edge Solar and would highly recommend them!
Best combination of quality panels and price. Prompt installation and great follow up on a few issues. Thank you.
